Why no exact locations?

To protect the children, families and homeless people we meet, we never publish an address or the name of an orphanage, a school or an outreach spot. The dots on the map are symbolic and match no real place. Registered volunteers receive meeting points privately.

Are you a charity or a church?

We love working together. Write to us to share a project or organize a food drive in your city.
